description: Solid timber cover board, often clasped, used chiefly for heavy volumes and books written on vellum. Its rigidity acts as a constant press that keeps moisture-sensitive leaves flat and prevents them from cockling.
name: wooden board

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter IX, p.124. Internet Archive.
